integrin_adhesome_network.description: Proteins presenting specific motifs that dictate integrin binding specificity.

modules.name: RGD
modules.function: Primary integrin-binding motif recognized by αV and α5β1 integrins.

modules.name: PHSRN
modules.function: Synergy site essential for high-affinity binding to α5β1.

modules.name: LDV
modules.function: Alternatively spliced segment recognized by α4β1 and α4β7.

modules.name: GFOGER
modules.function: Primary recognition site binding to the I-domain of collagen-binding integrins (α1β1, α2β1).

modules.name: Laminin Globular (LG) 1-3
modules.function: Mediate binding to α3β1, α6β1, and α7β1 integrins.

integrin_adhesome_network.description: Obligate heterodimers mediating direct cell-ECM attachment.

modules.name: MIDAS
modules.function: Metal Ion-Dependent Adhesion Site; coordinates Mg2+ or Mn2+ to directly bind acidic residues on ECM ligands.

modules.name: EGF-like Repeats
modules.function: Rigid structural domains in the β-stalk transmitting conformational changes during inside-out activation.

modules.name: GFFKR
modules.function: Forms a salt bridge with the β tail to maintain the low-affinity, inactive receptor state.

modules.name: NPxY / NxxY
modules.function: Primary docking sites for PTB domains of intracellular adaptors like Talin and Kindlin.

integrin_adhesome_network.description: Proteins directly binding integrin cytoplasmic tails to initiate activation.

modules.name: FERM (F3 Subdomain)
modules.function: Atypical PTB domain that recognizes the membrane-proximal NPxY motif of the β tail.

modules.name: Rod Domain (Mechanosensitive)
modules.function: Unfolds under physical tension to expose cryptic Vinculin-Binding Sites (VBS).

modules.name: Actin-Binding Sites (ABS)
modules.function: Direct connection to F-actin located at the C-terminus and within the rod/head.

modules.name: Bipartite FERM
modules.function: Binds the membrane-distal NxxY motif on the integrin β tail.

modules.name: PH
modules.function: Pleckstrin Homology domain; targets Kindlin to plasma membrane via phosphoinositides (PIP2/PIP3).

integrin_adhesome_network.description: Structural proteins reinforcing the adhesome-cytoskeleton connection.

modules.name: Head
modules.function: Binds exposed VBS motifs in mechanically stretched Talin.

modules.name: Tail
modules.function: Binds F-actin and membrane PIP2; normally auto-inhibited by the Head domain.

modules.name: CH (Calponin Homology)
modules.function: Paired N-terminal domains that cross-link actin filaments.

modules.name: Spectrin Repeats
modules.function: Central rod domains mediating anti-parallel dimerization.

modules.name: Ig-like Repeat 21
modules.function: Binds directly to the cytoplasmic tail of β integrins.

integrin_adhesome_network.description: Adaptor hubs that recruit signaling and structural proteins.

modules.name: LIM
modules.function: Zinc-finger motifs targeting paxillin to focal adhesions.

modules.name: LD
modules.function: Bind to FAK, vinculin, and ILK at the N-terminus.

modules.name: SH3
modules.function: Binds proline-rich sequences (PxxP) on FAK and other kinases.

modules.name: YxxP (Substrate Domain)
modules.function: Mechanosensitive motifs exposed under stretch; phosphorylated by Src to dock SH2 domains.

modules.name: Proline-Rich Regions
modules.function: Bind to Ena/VASP proteins to promote localized actin polymerization.

modules.name: FAT
modules.function: Focal Adhesion Targeting domain; binds LD motifs of Paxillin and FERM domain of Talin.

modules.name: Y397
modules.function: Autophosphorylation site creating a high-affinity binding dock for the Src SH2 domain.

modules.name: SH2
modules.function: Recognizes and binds phosphorylated tyrosines (e.g., FAK pY397).

modules.name: SH3
modules.function: Binds proline-rich (PxxP) motifs.

modules.name: Ankyrin (ANK) Repeats
modules.function: Binds to PINCH to form the IPP ternary signaling complex.

modules.name: Pseudokinase
modules.function: Scaffold binding the cytoplasmic tail of β1 and β3 integrins; lacks catalytic activity.
